verdict.rationale: Zoom's AI Services API reference and the live OpenAPI payload both declare a versioned API (API version 2) covering the Scribe endpoints. That delivers the versioning half of the story. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-migration guidance. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, deprecation/sunset timelines or notices, version migration guidance, independent corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Zoom's AI Services API reference identifies OpenAPI 3.1.1 and API version 2
the payload declares OpenAPI 3.0.0, AI Services API version 2, and six Scribe paths
